```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include "clipboard.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "docs.h"
#include "util.h"

static wchar_t* g_history[MAX_HISTORY];
int Clip_HistoryCount = 0;

void Clip_Add(const wchar_t* text)
{
    if (!text || Clip_HistoryCount >= MAX_HISTORY) return;
    g_history[Clip_HistoryCount++] = _wcsdup(text);
}

void Clip_DeleteAt(int index)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= Clip_HistoryCount) return;
    free(g_history[index]);
    for (int i = index; i < Clip_HistoryCount - 1; i++)
        g_history[i] = g_history[i + 1];
    Clip_HistoryCount--;
}

void Clip_ClearAll(void)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < Clip_HistoryCount; i++)
    {
        free(g_history[i]);
        g_history[i] = NULL;
    }
    Clip_HistoryCount = 0;
}

const wchar_t* Clip_GetAt(int index)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= Clip_HistoryCount) return NULL;
    return g_history[index];
}

void Clip_RefreshListBox(HWND hList)
{
    SendMessageW(hList, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < Clip_HistoryCount; i++)
        if (g_history[i])
            SendMessageW(hList, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)g_history[i]);
}

BOOL Clip_SaveToFile(HWND hWnd, const wchar_t* path)
{
    FILE* f = _wfopen(path, L"w, ccs=UTF-16LE");
    if (!f) { Util_ShowLastError(hWnd, L"Save Clipboard History"); return FALSE; }
    for (int i = 0; i < Clip_HistoryCount; i++)
        if (g_history[i])
            fwprintf(f, L"%ls\n", g_history[i]);
    fclose(f);
    return TRUE;
}

BOOL Clip_LoadFromFile(HWND hWnd, const wchar_t* path)
{
    FILE* f = _wfopen(path, L"r, ccs=UTF-16LE");
    if (!f) { Util_ShowLastError(hWnd, L"Load Clipboard History"); return FALSE; }

    Clip_ClearAll();

    wchar_t line[4096];
    while (fgetws(line, 4096, f) && Clip_HistoryCount < MAX_HISTORY)
    {
        size_t len = wcslen(line);
        if (len && line[len-1] == L'\n') line[len-1] = L'\0';
        Clip_Add(line);
    }
    fclose(f);
    return TRUE;
}

static void Clip_InsertSelectedIntoActiveEdit(HWND hDlg, HWND hList)
{
    int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
    if (sel == LB_ERR) return;
    const wchar_t* txt = Clip_GetAt(sel);
    if (!txt) return;

    HWND hMDIClient = GetParent(hDlg); // dialog’s owner is frame; parent is frame, client is global
    // More robust: find active edit via global MDI client
    extern HWND g_hMDIClient;
    HWND hEdit = Docs_GetActiveEdit(g_hMDIClient);
    if (hEdit)
        SendMessageW(hEdit, EM_REPLACESEL, TRUE, (LPARAM)txt);
}

INT_PTR CALLBACK ClipboardManagerDlgProc(HWND hDlg, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    HWND hList = GetDlgItem(hDlg, IDC_CLIPLIST);

    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_INITDIALOG:
        Clip_RefreshListBox(hList);
        return TRUE;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDC_INSERTCLIPENTRY:
            Clip_InsertSelectedIntoActiveEdit(hDlg, hList);
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_DELETECLIPENTRY:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR) { Clip_DeleteAt(sel); Clip_RefreshListBox(hList); }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_CLEARALLCLIPHIST:
            Clip_ClearAll();
            Clip_RefreshListBox(hList);
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_SAVECLIPHIST:
            Clip_SaveToFile(hDlg, L"clipboard_history.txt");
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_LOADCLIPHIST:
            if (Clip_LoadFromFile(hDlg, L"clipboard_history.txt"))
                Clip_RefreshListBox(hList);
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_CLOSECLIPMANAGER:
            EndDialog(hDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    }
    return FALSE;
}
```

```
﻿
#include <windows.h>

void CenterWindow(HWND hWnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetWindowRect(hWnd, &rc);
    int width = rc.right - rc.left;
    int height = rc.bottom - rc.top;

    RECT rcDesk;
    GetWindowRect(GetDesktopWindow(), &rcDesk);
    int screenWidth = rcDesk.right - rcDesk.left;
    int screenHeight = rcDesk.bottom - rcDesk.top;

    int x = (screenWidth - width) / 2;
    int y = (screenHeight - height) / 2;

    SetWindowPos(hWnd, NULL, x, y, 0, 0, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOSIZE);
}
```

```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include "handlers.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "clipboard.h"
#include "help_sys.h"
#include "about.h"
#include "sessions.h"

void HandleCommand(HWND hFrame, int cmdId)
{
    switch (cmdId)
    {
    case IDM_VIEW_CLIPHISTORY:
        DialogBoxW(GetModuleHandleW(NULL), MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_CLIPBOARDMANAGER),
                   hFrame, ClipboardManagerDlgProc);
        break;

    case IDM_VIEW_SESSIONS:
        DialogBoxW(GetModuleHandleW(NULL), MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_SESSIONMANAGER),
                   hFrame, SessionManagerDlgProc);
        break;
```

```
﻿#include "LDWINS.h"
#include "resources.h"

static const char FRAME_CLASS[] = "CopilotURL2Frame";
static const char CHILD_CLASS[] = "CopilotURL2Child";

HWND LDWINS_CreateFrame(HINSTANCE hInst, LPCSTR title,
                        WNDPROC wndProc,
                        LPCSTR menuRes,
                        LPCSTR toolbarRes,
                        LPCSTR statusRes)
{
    WNDCLASSA wc = {0};
    wc.lpfnWndProc = wndProc;
    wc.hInstance = hInst;
    wc.hIcon = LoadIconW(hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_MAINICON));
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1);
    wc.lpszClassName = FRAME_CLASS;
    RegisterClassA(&wc);

    WNDCLASSA wcc = {0};
    wcc.lpfnWndProc = DefMDIChildProcA;
    wcc.hInstance = hInst;
    wcc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_IBEAM);
    wcc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW+1);
    wcc.lpszClassName = CHILD_CLASS;
    RegisterClassA(&wcc);

    HWND hWnd = CreateWindowA(FRAME_CLASS, title,
                              WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_CLIPCHILDREN,
                              CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 1100, 740,
                              NULL, LoadMenuA(hInst, menuRes), hInst, NULL);
    return hWnd;
}

HWND LDWINS_CreateMDIClient(HWND hParent, HINSTANCE hInst, WNDPROC childProc)
{
    CLIENTCREATESTRUCT ccs = {0};
    ccs.hWindowMenu = GetSubMenu(GetMenu(hParent), 1);
    ccs.idFirstChild = 60000;

    HWND hMDIClient = CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE, "MDICLIENT", NULL,
                                      WS_CHILD | WS_CLIPCHILDREN | WS_VISIBLE | WS_VSCROLL | WS_HSCROLL,
                                      0, 0, 0, 0, hParent, (HMENU)1, hInst, &ccs);
    return hMDIClient;
}

HWND LDWINS_GetActiveChild(HWND hMDIClient)
{
    return (HWND)SendMessageW(hMDIClient, WM_MDIGETACTIVE, 0, 0);
}

HWND LDWINS_CreateMDIChild(HWND hMDIClient, HINSTANCE hInst,
                           LPCSTR title, WNDPROC childProc, DWORD style)
{
    MDICREATESTRUCTA mcs;
    mcs.szClass = CHILD_CLASS;
    mcs.szTitle = title;
    mcs.hOwner  = hInst;
    mcs.x = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.y = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.cx = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.cy = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    mcs.style = style;
    mcs.lParam = 0;

    return (HWND)SendMessageA(hMDIClient, WM_MDICREATE, 0, (LPARAM)&mcs);
}

void LDWINS_ResizeFrame(HWND hWnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(hWnd, &rc);
    HWND hMDIClient = FindWindowExA(hWnd, NULL, "MDICLIENT", NULL);
    if (hMDIClient)
        MoveWindow(hMDIClient, 0, 0, rc.right, rc.bottom, TRUE);
}
```

```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include "LDWINS.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "app.h"
#include "docs.h"
#include "clipboard.h"
#include "help_sys.h"
#include "about.h"
#include "util.h"
#include "sessions.h"

// Globals
HINSTANCE g_hInst = NULL;
HWND g_hMDIClient = NULL;

// Forward declarations
LRESULT CALLBACK FrameWndProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
LRESULT CALLBACK ChildProc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);

int APIENTRY wWinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE hPrevInstance,
                      LPWSTR lpCmdLine, int nCmdShow)
{
    g_hInst = hInstance;

    HWND hFrame = LDWINS_CreateFrame(hInstance, "CopilotURL2",
                                     FrameWndProc,
                                     MAKEINTRESOURCEA(IDR_MAINMENU),
                                     MAKEINTRESOURCEA(IDR_TOOLBAR),
                                     MAKEINTRESOURCEA(IDR_STATUS));
    if (!hFrame) return FALSE;

    ShowWindow(hFrame, nCmdShow);
    UpdateWindow(hFrame);

    // Create an initial document at startup
    LDWINS_CreateMDIChild(g_hMDIClient, g_hInst, "Document 1",
                          ChildProc, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW);

    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0))
    {
        if (!TranslateMDISysAccel(g_hMDIClient, &msg))
        {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
    }
    return (int)msg.wParam;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK FrameWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_CREATE:
        g_hMDIClient = LDWINS_CreateMDIClient(hWnd, g_hInst, ChildProc);
        return 0;

    case WM_SIZE:
        LDWINS_ResizeFrame(hWnd);
        return 0;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDM_FILE_NEW:
            LDWINS_CreateMDIChild(g_hMDIClient, g_hInst, "New Document",
                                  ChildProc, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW);
            return 0;

        case IDM_FILE_CLOSE:
            SendMessageW(g_hMDIClient, WM_MDIDESTROY, (WPARAM)LDWINS_GetActiveChild(g_hMDIClient), 0);
            return 0;

        case IDM_FILE_EXIT:
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;

        case IDM_EDIT_UNDO:
        case IDM_EDIT_REDO:
        case IDM_EDIT_COPY:
        case IDM_EDIT_CUT:
        case IDM_EDIT_PASTE:
        case IDM_EDIT_SELECTALL:
            Docs_ForwardEditCommand(g_hMDIClient, LOWORD(wParam));
            return 0;

        case IDM_VIEW_CLIPHISTORY:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_CLIPBOARDMANAGER), hWnd, ClipboardManagerDlgProc);
            return 0;

        case IDM_VIEW_SESSIONS:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_SESSIONMANAGER), hWnd, SessionManagerDlgProc);
            return 0;

        case IDM_HELP_HELP:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_HELPDIALOG), hWnd, HelpDlgProc);
            return 0;

        case IDM_HELP_ABOUT:
            DialogBoxW(g_hInst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDD_ABOUTBOX), hWnd, AboutDlgProc);
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_DESTROY:
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefFrameProcW(hWnd, g_hMDIClient, message, wParam, lParam);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK ChildProc(HWND hWnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_CREATE:
        Docs_CreateEditor(hWnd, g_hInst);
        return 0;

    case WM_SETFOCUS:
        SetFocus(GetWindow(hWnd, GW_CHILD));
        return 0;
    }
    return DefMDIChildProcW(hWnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}
```

```
﻿#include <windows.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include "sessions.h"
#include "resources.h"
#include "clipboard.h"

static CLIPSESSION g_sessions[32];
static int g_sessionCount = 0;

static void Sessions_RefreshList(HWND hList)
{
    SendMessageW(hList, LB_RESETCONTENT, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_sessionCount; i++)
        SendMessageW(hList, LB_ADDSTRING, 0, (LPARAM)g_sessions[i].name);
}

INT_PTR CALLBACK SessionManagerDlgProc(HWND hDlg, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    HWND hList = GetDlgItem(hDlg, IDC_SESSIONLIST);

    switch (message)
    {
    case WM_INITDIALOG:
        Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
        return TRUE;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam))
        {
        case IDC_NEWSESSION:
            if (g_sessionCount < 32)
            {
                int idx = g_sessionCount++;
                swprintf(g_sessions[idx].name, 64, L"Session %d", idx + 1);
                swprintf(g_sessions[idx].filePath, MAX_PATH, L"session_%d.txt", idx + 1);
                Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
            }
            return TRUE;

        case IDC_DELETESESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
            {
                for (int i = sel; i < g_sessionCount - 1; i++)
                    g_sessions[i] = g_sessions[i + 1];
                g_sessionCount--;
                Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
            }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_LOADSESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
            {
                Clip_LoadFromFile(hDlg, g_sessions[sel].filePath);
                // No list to refresh here; this dialog lists sessions only.
            }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_SAVESESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
                Clip_SaveToFile(hDlg, g_sessions[sel].filePath);
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_RENAMESESSION:
        {
            int sel = (int)SendMessageW(hList, LB_GETCURSEL, 0, 0);
            if (sel != LB_ERR)
            {
                // Simple rename: append "*"
                wcscat(g_sessions[sel].name, L"*");
                Sessions_RefreshList(hList);
            }
            return TRUE;
        }

        case IDC_CLOSESESSIONMGR:
            EndDialog(hDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    }
    return FALSE;
}
```

```
﻿#include "util.h"

void Util_CenterWindow(HWND hWnd)
{
    RECT rc;
    GetWindowRect(hWnd, &rc);
    int width = rc.right - rc.left;
    int height = rc.bottom - rc.top;

    RECT rcDesk;
    GetWindowRect(GetDesktopWindow(), &rcDesk);
    int screenWidth = rcDesk.right - rcDesk.left;
    int screenHeight = rcDesk.bottom - rcDesk.top;

    int x = (screenWidth - width) / 2;
    int y = (screenHeight - height) / 2;

    SetWindowPos(hWnd, NULL, x, y, 0, 0, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOSIZE);
}

void Util_ShowLastError(HWND hWnd, LPCWSTR title)
{
    DWORD err = GetLastError();
    LPWSTR buf = NULL;
    FormatMessageW(FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER | FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM |
                   FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
                   NULL, err, 0, (LPWSTR)&buf, 0, NULL);
    MessageBoxW(hWnd, buf ? buf : L"(no message)", title, MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    if (buf) LocalFree(buf);
}
```

```
    Macro_Page_.INTVL = GetTickCount
    REC_MCRO_PTR Macro_Page_
    NXT_PGE Macro_Page_ 'Last sub before shift
    Macro_Page_ = Macro_Page_EMPTY
End Sub

Public Function REC_MCRO(Macro_Page As MacroStruct) As MacroStruct
    Macro_Page.INTVL = GetTickCount
    REC_MCRO_PTR Macro_Page
    NXT_PGE Macro_Page 'Last sub before shift
    REC_MCRO = Macro_Page
 End Function

Public Function NXT_PGE(Macro_Page As MacroStruct) As MacroStruct
    If CHK_VAL_cCWIN_ Then Macro_Page.MMsg.CallWin = True
    If CHK_VAL_cUI_ Then Macro_Page.MMsg.cUI = True
        If bMCRO Then
            If MPPage = szMPGE Then CMD_MCRO False: UnhookMouse False
                'testshowPage Macro_Page
                If MPPage_bool = False Then MPPage_bool = True
                MacroPage(MPPage) = Macro_Page
                MPPage = MPPage + 1
            End If
    NXT_PGE = Macro_Page
End Function

Public Sub PRNT_MCRO_PGE()
    If Not MPPage_bool Then Exit Sub
    
    'public Const szMPG = 19 'size of macro
    
     Dim HXA As Integer
     Dim sMPG(szMPG) As String
     Dim szCSV As Integer
     szCSV = MPPage - 1
     
     'ReDim sMPG(20)
     Dim sfMPG() As String
     Dim csvMPG As String
     ReDim sfMPG(szCSV)
     'Dim iHXA As Integer
     
     For HXA = 0 To szCSV
        MacroPage(HXA).PGE_IDX = HXA
        sMPG(0) = MacroPage(HXA).PGE_IDX
        sMPG(1) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.KEYS.MMKey
        sMPG(2) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.KEYS.MMWrap
        sMPG(3) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.CallWin
        sMPG(4) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.IVK.sTXT
        sMPG(5) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.style.CEcho
        sMPG(6) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.style.CNormal
        sMPG(7) = MacroPage(HXA).points.X
        sMPG(8) = MacroPage(HXA).points.Y
        sMPG(9) = MacroPage(HXA).Bpage.LDown
        sMPG(10) = MacroPage(HXA).Bpage.LUp
        sMPG(11) = MacroPage(HXA).Bpage.RDown
        sMPG(12) = MacroPage(HXA).Bpage.RUP
        sMPG(13) = MacroPage(HXA).Bpage.MDown
        sMPG(14) = MacroPage(HXA).Bpage.MUp
        sMPG(15) = MacroPage(HXA).PGE_KBD
        sMPG(16) = MacroPage(HXA).INTVL
        sMPG(17) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.cUI
        sMPG(18) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.oCCP
        sMPG(19) = MacroPage(HXA).MMsg.IVK.CSK
        sfMPG(HXA) = Chr_FIO(sMPG)
        DoEvents
    Next HXA
    
    csvMPG = Chr_FIO1(sfMPG)
    SWG.SWGC1.FTxtT_ csvMPG
    
End Sub

SWG.SWGC1.TxtT_ ""
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "FX_HOOK"
Private Declare Function UnhookWindowsHookEx Lib "user32" (ByVal hHook As Long) As Long
Private Declare Function SetWindowsHook Lib "user32" Alias "SetWindowsHookA" (ByVal nFilterType As Long, ByVal pfnFilterProc As Long) As Long
Private Declare Function SetWindowsHookEx Lib "user32" Alias "SetWindowsHookExA" (ByVal idHook As Long, ByVal lpfn As Long, ByVal hmod As Long, ByVal dwThreadId As Long) As Long
Private Declare Function CallNextHookEx Lib "user32" (ByVal hHook As Long, ByVal ncode As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, lParam As Any) As Long
Private Const HC_Action As Integer = 0
Private Const WH_MOUSE_LL As Integer = 14

Private Const WM_LBUTTONDOWN = &H201
Private Const WM_LBUTTONUP = &H202
Private Const WM_MBUTTONDOWN = &H207
Private Const WM_MBUTTONUP = &H208
Private Const WM_RBUTTONDOWN = &H204
Private Const WM_RBUTTONUP = &H205
Private Const WM_MOUSEACTIVATE = &H21
Private Const WM_MOUSEFIRST = &H200
Private Const WM_MOUSELAST = &H209
Private Const WM_MOUSEMOVE = &H200
Private MouseHookID As Long
Public HookStatus As String

Private Function MouseProc(ByVal ncode As Integer, ByVal wParam As Integer, ByVal lParam As Integer) As Integer

       If ncode = 0 And Not DNR Then
       HookStatus = ""
            Select Case wParam
                Case WM_LBUTTONDOWN
                     HookStatus = "WM_LD"
                If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(0) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.LDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_RBUTTONDOWN
                   HookStatus = "WM_RD"
                If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(2) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MBUTTONDOWN
                    HookStatus = "WM_MD"
                If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(4) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.MDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_LBUTTONUP
                     HookStatus = "WM_LU"
                If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(1) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.LUp = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_RBUTTONUP
                     HookStatus = "WM_RBU"
                If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(3) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RUP = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MBUTTONUP
                     HookStatus = "WM_MU"
                If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(5) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.MUp = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK
                     HookStatus = "WM_LBDB"
                'If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(2) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RUP = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_RBUTTONDBLCLK
                     HookStatus = "WM_RBDB"
                'If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(6) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.MDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MBUTTONDBLCLK
                     HookStatus = "WM_MBDB"
                'If SWG.SWGC1.nchkBTN(10) And bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.MDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MOUSEACTIVATE
                    HookStatus = "WM_MA"
                'If bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MOUSEFIRST
                    HookStatus = "WM_MF"
                'If bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MOUSELAST
                    HookStatus = "WM_ML"
                'If bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case WM_MOUSEMOVE
                    HookStatus = "WM_MM"
                'If bMCRO Then Macro_Page_.Bpage.RDown = True: REC_MCRO_HOOK
                Case Else
                    HookStatus = "Pointer Failed" & Chr(32) & ncode
            End Select
                   
                 HookStatus = HookStatus & Chr(32) & DISP_CPOS
        Else
        HookStatus = "NO HOOK::"
        End If

        SWG.SWGC1.gLBL_(0) = HookStatus
        
    'Exit Function
    'MouseProc = CallNextHookEx(MouseHookID, ncode, wParam, lParam)
    End Function

    Public Sub HookMouse()
        If MouseHookID = 0 Then
            MouseHookID = SetWindowsHookEx(WH_MOUSE_LL, AddressOf MouseProc, 0, 0)
            If MouseHookID = 0 Then
               HookStatus = "Failed Hook"
                Else
               HookStatus = "Hooked"
            End If
        End If
    End Sub

    Public Sub UnhookMouse(Optional newHook As Boolean = True)
        If MouseHookID Then
                UnhookWindowsHookEx MouseHookID
                MouseHookID = 0
                HookStatus = "Unhooked"
                SWG.SWGC1.gLBL_(0) = HookStatus
            Else
               If newHook Then HookMouse
        End If
    End Sub
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "CV_HEX"
Public Const EVNT_UDMI_LULEN = 29 'CM_BUFF
Private GHX_BUF As EVNT_UDMI_ 'make public
Public EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB As Long  'CM_BUFF
Public wwEVNT_UDMI_LULEN As Integer 'expired

Public GUIDS(1 To cMDE_ULEN) As LEVNT_UDMI_

Private Type DRVR_
    Drvr As Boolean
    Adptr As Boolean
    bFile(1 To cMDE_ULEN) As Boolean
    lFile() As Long
End Type

Public Adptr As DRVR_

Public Sub SWTCH_DRVR()
    Dim iUDM As Integer
    Dim HXA As Byte
    Dim UB_GXBUFF As Long
        UB_GXBUFF = EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB
        
        Dim GHX_BUF_ As EVNT_UDMI_
        ReDim GHX_BUF_.cBnd(UB_GXBUFF)
        
            If Adptr.Drvr Then
                EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB = EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB + 1
                GHX_BUF_.cBnd = GHX_BUF.cBnd
            End If

        ReDim GHX_BUF.cBnd(EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB)
            
            If EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB > 0 Then
                
                    For iUDM = HXF To UB_GXBUFF
                        GHX_BUF.cBnd(iUDM).buf = GHX_BUF_.cBnd(iUDM).buf
                    Next iUDM
            Else
                Adptr.Drvr = True
            End If
                
       GHX_BUF.cBnd(EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB).buf = Adptr.lFile

End Sub

Public Sub SWTCH_ADPTR(GUI As GUI_)
    Dim iUDM As Integer
    Dim HXA As Byte
    Dim UB_GXBUFF As Long
        UB_GXBUFF = GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN
        
        Dim GUIDS__ As LEVNT_UDMI_
        ReDim GUIDS__.buf(UB_GXBUFF)
        
            If Adptr.bFile(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE) Then
                GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN = GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN + 1
                GUIDS__.buf = GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).buf
            End If
             
            ReDim GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).buf(GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN)
            
            If GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN > 0 Then
                
                    For iUDM = HXF To UB_GXBUFF
                        GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).buf(iUDM) = GUIDS__.buf(iUDM)
                    Next iUDM
            Else
                Adptr.bFile(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE) = True
            End If
                
       GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).buf(GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN) = GUI.GUID
End Sub

Public Function GUIDS_(GUI As GUI_) As Byte
    Dim HXA As Integer
        For HXA = 0 To GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).ULEN
            If GUIDS(GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE).buf(HXA) = GUI.GUID Then
                GUIDS_ = GUI.CMI.CMDE.MDE
                Exit For
            End If
        Next HXA
End Function

Public Function C_HX_BUF(GHX As GHX_) As Long
    Dim HXB As Boolean
        For GHX.iUDM = HXF To EVNT_UDMI_LULEN_VB
            HXB = True
                        For GHX.iHex = HXF To GHX.XV.UV.EVNT_UDMI_HULEN
                            HXB = HXB And GHX.UDMI.oBnd(GHX.iHex) = GHX_BUF.cBnd(GHX.iUDM).buf(GHX.iHex)
                            If Not HXB Then Exit For
                        Next GHX.iHex
                    If HXB Then C_HX_BUF = DEC_HEX2(GHX.iUDM, GHX.iHex): Exit Function
        Next GHX.iUDM
End Function
```

```
Public Sub SetFullScreen(Optional cCWIN As Boolean = True)
        If cCWIN Then
        BringWindowToTop Wins.Frame
         SetForegroundWindow Wins.Frame
         SetActiveWindow Wins.Frame
            EnableWindow Wins.Frame, True
            VbSleep (500)
             SendMessage Wins.Frame, WM_MOUSEACTIVATE, 0, 0
            VbSleep (100)
        'SetFocusAPI GAME_WIN
        'SetWindowPos GAME_WIN, HWND_TOP, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NO_MOVE + SWP_NO_SIZE
        Else
        SETF_FTXT_
        End If
End Sub

    SetForegroundWindow SWG.hwnd
    SetActiveWindow SWG.hwnd
    EnableWindow SWG.hwnd, True
End Sub

    getwinTOP.x = winT.rcNormalPosition.Left
    getwinTOP.y = winT.rcNormalPosition.Top
```

```
fld(0).Required = True

Next i

IDX(0).Fields.Append fld(0)
Tbl.Indexes.Append IDX(0)
DbDao.TableDefs.Append Tbl
```

```
Public Sub SND_IVK_REC(sTXT As String, cUI_ As Byte, frmTXT_ As Byte, oCCP_ As Byte)
    Dim Macro_Page As MacroStruct
        Macro_Page.PGE_KBD = True
        Macro_Page.MMsg.oCCP = oCCP_
        
            Select Case GSO_OPT1_
                Case 0:  Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.sTXT = M_echo & sTXT: Macro_Page.MMsg.style.CEcho = True
                Case 1:  Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.sTXT = sTXT: Macro_Page.MMsg.style.CNormal = True
            End Select
            Select Case oCCP_
                Case 0
                    Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.sTXT = sTXT
                    Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.CSK = True
                Case 1
                Select Case GSO_OPT2_
                    Case 0: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMKey = MWU.MW_NONE: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMWrap = MTP.MT_NONE
                    Case 1: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMKey = MWU.MW_lo: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMWrap = MTP.MT_Return
                    Case 2: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMKey = MWU.MW_hi: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMWrap = MTP.MT_Return
                    Case 3: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMKey = MWU.MW_all: Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMWrap = MTP.MT_Return
                End Select
            End Select
                 If bMCRO Then
                    Macro_Page = REC_MCRO(Macro_Page)
                 Else
                    Macro_Page = NXT_PGE(Macro_Page)
                 End If
                    SetFullScreen Macro_Page.MMsg.CallWin
        SND_KEY_IV Macro_Page
End Sub

Public Sub SND_KEY_IV(Macro_Page As MacroStruct, Optional rREC As Boolean = False)
        If Macro_Page.MMsg.cUI Then
            CSK_SCRPT Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.sTXT
        Else
            Select Case Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMKey
                Case MWU.MW_NONE:
                     IVK_SCRPT Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.sTXT
                Case Else
                     IVK_CSK Macro_Page.MMsg.IVK.sTXT, CByte(Macro_Page.MMsg.KEYS.MMKey)
            End Select
        End If
End Sub

Public Function SCP(PI As POINTAPI)
        SetCursorPos PI.x, PI.y
        VbSleep (25)
End Function

Public Function RET_CX() As Long
    Dim CPOS As POINTAPI
        GetCursorPos CPOS
        RET_CX = CPOS.x
End Function

Public Function RET_CY() As Long
    Dim CPOS As POINTAPI
        GetCursorPos CPOS
        RET_CY = CPOS.y
End Function

Public Sub RET_CPOS()
    CCUR_POS.x = RET_CX
    CCUR_POS.y = RET_CY
End Sub

Public Function DISP_CPOS() As String
    RET_CPOS
    DISP_CPOS = CCUR_POS.x & "," & CCUR_POS.y
End Function
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "FEL_HEX"
Private Const Hex_8 = &H10000000
Private Const Hex_7 = &H1000000
Private Const Hex_6 = &H100000
Private Const Hex_5 = &H10000
Private Const Hex_4 = &H1000
Private Const Hex_3 = &H100
Private Const Hex_2 = &H10
Private Const Hex_1 = &H1

Public Function C_HEX(XV As XV_, CMI As cMI_, OPT As GUI_OPT, BRS As GUI_BRS) As GUI_
    
    Dim GHX As GHX_
    
    C_HEX.CMI = CMI
    C_HEX.gBRS = BRS
    C_HEX.gOPT = OPT
    GHX.XV = XV
    
    Dim HXE As Boolean
    Dim HXA As Integer
    
    For GHX.iUDM = HXF To XV.UV.UDMI_LEN
    For GHX.iHex = HXR To XV.UV.UDMI_HEX_ULEN
    
            Select Case GHX.iUDM
             Case 0
                    Select Case GHX.iHex
                        Case 1
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).byt = CMI.cIDX.IDX
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt = CMI.cIDX.cdt
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).CMT = CMI.cIDX.wcCMT
                        Case 2
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).byt = CMI.cMDE.MDE
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt = CMI.cMDE.cdt
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).CMT = CMI.cMDE.wcCMT
    
                        Case Else: XElse = True
                    End Select
                    
             Case 1
    
                    Select Case GHX.iHex
                        Case 1
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).BoolORabs = OPT.BTN.CLK
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt = OPT.BTN.cdt
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).CMT = OPT.BTN.wcCMT
                        Case Else: XElse = True
                    End Select
                    
                Case 2
    
                    Select Case GHX.iHex
                        Case 1
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).byt = OPT.mOPT.GSO
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt = OPT.mOPT.cdt
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).CMT = OPT.mOPT.wcCMT
                             
                        Case 2
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).byt = OPT.bOPT.GSO
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt = OPT.bOPT.cdt
                             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).CMT = OPT.bOPT.wcCMT
    
                        Case Else: XElse = True
                    End Select
                Case 3
                        Select Case GHX.iHex
                            Case 1
                                For HXA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_LST_ULEN
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).IntORAbs = BRS.Lst(HXA).gSI
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).cdt = BRS.Lst(HXA).iCDT
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).CMT = BRS.Lst(HXA).wcCMT
                                 GHX.iHex = XV.FV.BRS_LST_ULEN
                                Next HXA
                            Case Else: HXE = True
                        End Select
                Case 4
                        Select Case GHX.iHex
                            Case 1
                                For HXA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_LST_ULEN
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).str = BRS.Lst(HXA).txt
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).cdt = BRS.Lst(HXA).sCDT
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).CMT = BRS.Lst(HXA).wcCMT
                                 GHX.iHex = XV.FV.BRS_LST_ULEN
                                Next HXA
                            Case Else: HXE = True
                        End Select
                Case 5
                        Select Case GHX.iHex
                            Case 1
                                For HXA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_TXT_ULEN
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).str = BRS.txt(HXA).txt
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).cdt = BRS.txt(HXA).cdt
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).CMT = BRS.txt(HXA).wcCMT
                                 GHX.iHex = XV.FV.BRS_TXT_ULEN
                                Next HXA
                            Case Else: HXE = True
                        End Select
                Case 6
                        Select Case GHX.iHex
                            Case 1
                                For HXA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_CPT_ULEN
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).str = BRS.CPT(HXA).gCPT
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).cdt = BRS.CPT(HXA).cdt
                                 GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(HXA).CMT = BRS.CPT(HXA).wcCMT
                                 GHX.iHex = XV.FV.BRS_CPT_ULEN
                                Next HXA
                            Case Else: HXE = True
                        End Select
            End Select
        If HXE Then 'Empty
            HXE = False
             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).BoolORabs = XV.UV.BOOL
             GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt = CMI.cIDX.cdt
        End If

    Next GHX.iHex
    Next GHX.iUDM
    
    C_HEX.GHX = GHX
    C_HEX.GHX.UDMI = C_UDM(GHX)
    C_HEX.XV = XV
End Function

Public Function C_UDM(GHX1 As GHX_) As UDMI_
Dim GHX As GHX_
GHX = GHX1
    For GHX.iUDM = HXF To GHX.XV.UV.UDMI_LEN
        For GHX.iHex = HXR To GHX.XV.UV.UDMI_HEX_ULEN
                Select Case GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt
                               
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.BOOL
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).BOOL = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).BoolORabs
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.byte
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).byt = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).byt
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.Int
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).Int = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).IntORAbs
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.str
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).str = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).str
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.iAbs
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).Int = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).IntORAbs
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.ibool
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).Int = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).IntORAbs
                        Case GHX.XV.UV.bAbs
                             GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).BOOL = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).BoolORabs
                End Select
            GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).CMT = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).CMT
            GHX.UDMI.iBND(GHX.iUDM).HX(GHX.iHex).cdt = GHX.UBUF(GHX.iUDM).Buf(GHX.iHex).cdt
        Next GHX.iHex
    Next GHX.iUDM
    C_UDM = GHX.UDMI
End Function

Public Function X_HEX(GUI1 As GUI_) As GUI_
Dim GUI As GUI_
GUI = GUI1
    Dim HXO As Integer
    Dim HXA(1 To 8) As Long 'HXO
    Dim iDR As Long
    Dim iDN As Byte
    Dim iDP As Long
    
    GUI = GUI
    
        GUI.GHX.iHex = HXR
        
        HXA(1) = Hex_8: ' GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(2) = Hex_7: ' GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(3) = Hex_6: ' GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(4) = Hex_5: 'GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(5) = Hex_4: 'GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(6) = Hex_3: 'GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(7) = Hex_2: 'GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
        HXA(8) = Hex_1: 'GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR 'reset
        
            For GUI.GHX.iUDM = HXF To GUI.XV.UV.UDMI_LEN
            
                GUI.GHX.iHex = HXR
                iDR = HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex): GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
             
                    For GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex To GUI.XV.UV.UDMI_HEX_ULEN
                      GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex - HXR
                        
                        Select Case GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).cdt
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.BOOL
                                iDN = Abs(CInt(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).BOOL))
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.byte
                                iDN = GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).byt
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.Int
                                iDN = GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).Int + HXR
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.str
                                iDN = Abs(CBool(Len(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).str) > 0))
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.iAbs
                                iDN = Abs(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).Int)
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.ibool
                                iDN = Abs(CBool(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).Int > -1))
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                            Case GUI.XV.UV.bAbs
                                iDN = Abs(CInt(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(GUI.GHX.iUDM).HX(GUI.GHX.iHex).BOOL))
                                iDP = iDN * HXA(GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR): iDR = iDR + iDP
                        End Select
                    GUI.GHX.iHex = GUI.GHX.iHex + HXR
                
                    Next GUI.GHX.iHex
                    
           GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(GUI.GHX.iUDM) = iDR
         Next GUI.GHX.iUDM
    
    X_HEX = GUI
End Function

Public Function hex_1f(GF As GF_) As GF_
    If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbDirectory = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbDirectory Then GF.WF.DL.hxf1 = 1
    If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbArchive = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbArchive Then GF.WF.DL.hxf1 = GF.WF.DL.hxf1 + 2
    If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbNormal = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbNormal Then GF.WF.DL.hxf1 = GF.WF.DL.hxf1 + 4
    If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbReadOnly = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbReadOnly Then GF.WF.DL.hxf1 = GF.WF.DL.hxf1 + 8
    If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbSystem = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbSystem Then GF.WF.DL.hxf1 = GF.WF.DL.hxf1 + 17
hex_1f = GF
End Function
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "FI_FX"
Public Function FX_FDN(GF1 As GF_) As FL_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
        GF.WF.url.DI.FDE = GF.WF.url.DI.EP(0)
        GF.WF.url.FI.FFN = GF.WF.url.DI.FDE
    FX_FDN = GF.WF
End Function

Public Function FX_FFN(GF1 As GF_) As FL_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
             GF.WF.url.FI.EXT = Fext_bin
             GF.WF.url.DI.FDE = GF.WF.url.DI.EP(0)
             GF.WF.url.FI.FNME = GF.WF.url.DI.FDE
             GF.WF.url.DI.EP(1) = eFF(FFX(GF.WF.url.DI.FDE, GF.WF.url.FI.EXT, True).Lst)
             GF.WF.url.FI.FFN = GF.WF.url.DI.EP(1)
    FX_FFN = GF.WF
End Function

Public Function FX_EXE(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
        Dim iHex As Byte
            For iHex = GF.WF.url.FI.LCDR To GF.WF.url.FI.HCDR
                Select Case iHex
                    Case 0: GF.WF = APTH(GF.WF)
                    Case 1: GF.WF = DPTH(GF.WF)
                    Case 2: GF.WF = BPTH(GF.WF)
                    
                End Select
                GF.WF = FFX_(GF.WF, iHex)
            Next iHex
            
            Dim NUL As Boolean
            Dim OL As OL_
                
                NUL = Len(GF.WF.url.DI.FDB) > 0
                ReDim OL.Lst(1 + Abs(CInt(NUL)))
                OL.Lst(0) = GF.WF.url.DI.FDA
                OL.Lst(1) = GF.WF.url.DI.FDD
                If NUL Then OL.Lst(2) = GF.WF.url.DI.FDB
                GF.WF.url.FDI = dFF(OL.Lst)
                
                If Not GF.WF.url.NXT.NXTFIO And GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbDF Then
                    NUL = Len(GF.WF.url.FI.FFN) > 0
                    ReDim OL.Lst(Abs(CInt(NUL)))
                    OL.Lst(0) = GF.WF.url.FDI
                    If NUL Then OL.Lst(1) = GF.WF.url.FI.FFN
                    GF.WF.url.FPF = dFF(OL.Lst)
                End If
                
                If GF.WF.url.NXT.NXTBT > 0 Then
                    NUL = Len(GF.WF.url.DI.FDE) > 0
                    ReDim OL.Lst(Abs(CInt(NUL)))
                    OL.Lst(0) = GF.WF.url.FDI
                    If NUL Then OL.Lst(1) = GF.WF.url.DI.FDE
                    GF.WF.url.FPD = dFF(OL.Lst)
                    GF.WF.url.FIOD = GF.WF.url.FPD
                Else
                    GF.WF.url.FIOD = GF.WF.url.FDI
                End If
                

                
    FX_EXE = GF
End Function

Public Function FFX_(FL1 As FL_, iHex As Byte) As FL_
    Dim FL As FL_
    Dim sFFX As String
    Dim sz_FFX As Boolean
    Dim LWP As String
    Dim HWP As String
    FL = FL1
    
        Select Case iHex
            Case 0: LWP = FL.url.DI.aPN: HWP = vbNullString
            Case 1: LWP = FL.url.DI.dPN: HWP = FL.url.DI.dPN
            Case 2: LWP = FL.url.DI.bPN: HWP = FL.url.DI.bPN
            
        End Select
    
    sFFX = FFX_RET(LWP, HWP, sz_FFX)
    
        Select Case iHex
            Case 0: FL.url.DI.FDA = sFFX
            Case 1: FL.url.DI.FDD = sFFX
            Case 2: FL.url.DI.FDB = sFFX
            
        End Select
        
    FFX_ = FL
End Function

Public Function FFX(LWP As String, Optional HWP As String = vbNullString, Optional sz_FFX As Boolean = False) As OL_
    Dim OL As OL_
        ReDim OL.Lst(Abs(CInt(sz_FFX)))
            OL.Lst(0) = LWP
                If sz_FFX Then OL.Lst(1) = HWP
    FFX.Lst = OL.Lst
End Function

Public Function FFX_RET(LWP As String, HWP As String, sz_FFX As Boolean) As String
    If Not sz_FFX Then
        FFX_RET = dFF(FFX(LWP).Lst)
    Else
        FFX_RET = dFF(FFX(LWP, HWP, sz_FFX).Lst)
    End If
End Function
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "FI_FO_IO"

Public Function FIO_PTH(GF1 As GF_, Optional MDE As Byte = 0) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            GF.WF = CHK_FD(GF.WF)
            GF.WF = CHK_DIR(GF.WF, MDE)
                If Not GF.WF.url.NXT.NXTFIO Then
                  GF = FIO(GF)
                End If
        FIO_PTH = GF
End Function

Public Function FIO(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            GF.WF = CHK_FF(GF.WF)
           GF = FIO_(GF)
        FIO = GF
End Function

Public Function OFIO(GF1 As GF_, fWrite As Boolean) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            If fWrite Then
                GF.WF = OF_OUT(GF.WF)
                    If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.oB Then
                        GF.WF = FO_DTA(GF.WF)
                        GF.WF = WF_OUT(GF.WF)
                    End If
                Else
                    GF.WF = OF_IN(GF.WF)
                    GF.WF = RF_IN(GF.WF)
                        If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.rB Then
                            FI_DTA GF.WF
                        End If
            End If
    GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.oB = OF_CLS(GF.WF.FD.iFN)
    OFIO = GF
End Function

Public Function FIO_(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.BTN.CLK
                Case True
                    Select Case GF.GUI.CMI.cIDX.IDX
                        Case 1
                             Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO = 1
                                Case True ' no asmbl
                                    GF = OFIO(GF, GF.GUI.gOPT.BTN.CLK)
                              End Select
                        Case 2 'open edit
                                Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO
                                Case 1 ' no asmbl
                                    Enable_EDIT_NEW GF
                                End Select
                        Case 3  'delete
                            Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO = 2
                                Case True ' no asmbl
                                    If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.fB Then
                                        If MsgBox(GF.WF.url.FI.FNME, vbYesNo, "Delete " & GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.bOPT(GF.GUI.gOPT.bOPT.GSO) & "?") = vbYes Then
                                               ' If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbDE Then
                                              '      KILL_D GF.WF.url.FIOD
                                              '  Else
                                                    KILL_F GF.WF.url.FPF
                                              '  End If
                                            GF = FIX_SEL(GF, GF.GUI.XV.FV.fixSEL.fsKILL)
                                        End If
                                    Else
                                        MSG_ "File not found::" & GF.WF.url.FI.FFN
                                    End If
                            End Select
                    End Select
                Case False
                GF = OFIO(GF, GF.GUI.gOPT.BTN.CLK)
            End Select
    FIO_ = GF
End Function
```

```
Public Function BP_(FL1 As FL_) As FL_
    Dim FL As FL_
    FL = FL1
 
        Dim HXA1 As Byte
        Dim HXA2 As Byte

           ub(0) = UBound(FL.url.DI.PN(0).BP)
           ub(1) = UBound(FL.url.DI.PN(1).BP)

            HXA2 = 1 + ub(0) + ub(1) - Abs(CInt(FL.url.DI.PN(1).NUL))
            ReDim FL.url.DI.BP(HXA2)

            FL.url.DI.BP(HXF) = FL.url.DI.PN(HXF).BP(HXF):
            
    For HXA1 = HXR To HXA2 'If HXA1 < FL.url.DI.gOPT Then
         HXA3 = HXA3 + 1: FL.url.DI.BP(HXA1) = FL.url.DI.PN(HXF).BP(HXA3): HXA1 = HXA1 + 1:
            If HXA1 <= HXA2 Then If Not FL.url.DI.PN(HXR).NUL Then FL.url.DI.BP(HXA1) = FL.url.DI.PN(HXR).BP(HXA3 - HXR)
    Next HXA1

    BP_ = FL
```

```
                Select Case GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbDF
                    Case True:
                        If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbDR And (GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.rB Or GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.wB) Then vbROPT = True
                    Case False:
                        If GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.rB Then vbROPT = True

                    Select Case icase
```

```
Public Function OF_IO(FL1 As FL_, IO As Boolean) As FL_
    Dim FL As FL_
    FL = FL1
    
    Select Case FL.url.DI.BOOL.oB Or FL.url.DI.BOOL.wB
        Case False
           ' MsgBox FL.url.FPF, vbOK, "Invalid directory"
           MSG_ "Invalid directory"
                FL.url.FI.BOOL.fB = False
                FL.url.FI.BOOL.oB = False
                FL.url.DI.BOOL.rP = False
        Case True
            Select Case FL.url.FI.BOOL.fB
                Case True
                    'If MsgBox(FL.url.FPF, vbYesNo, "Access File") = vbYes Then
                     MSG_ "Access File"
                    FL.url.FI.BOOL.rP = vbYes
                Case False
                    'If MsgBox(FL.url.FPF, vbYesNo, "Create File") = vbYes Then
                     MSG_ "Create File"
                    FL.url.FI.BOOL.rP = vbYes
            End Select
    End Select
    
    Select Case FL.url.FI.BOOL.rP = vbYes
        Case True
            Select Case FL.FD.iFN
                Case 0
                    FL.FD.iFN = FreeFile
                        If IO Then
                            Open FL.url.FPF For Binary Access Write As #FL.FD.iFN
                        Else
                            Open FL.url.FPF For Binary Access Read As #FL.FD.iFN
                        End If
                    FL.url.FI.BOOL.oB = True
                Case Else
                    'MsgBox "File is  open::#" & FL.FD.iFN & "::" & FL.url.FPF, vbOK, "Access Report::File Found"
                    MSG_ "File is  open::#" & FL.FD.iFN & "::" & FL.url.FPF
                    FL.url.FI.BOOL.WFID = FL.FD.iFN
                    FL.url.FI.BOOL.FF = True
            End Select
        Case False
    End Select
OF_IO = FL
End Function

Public Function WF_OUT(FL1 As FL_) As FL_
    Dim FL As FL_
    FL = FL1
    Dim LTA As Long
    Dim szLTA As Long
    Dim nRec As Long
    Dim tmp As Long
        If FL.url.FI.BOOL.oB Then
        FL.FD.DTA = FL.FD.DTA & Chr(0)
         LTA = Len(FL.FD.DTA)
         tmp = LTA
         nRec = 1
                    Dim DTA As String
                    szLTA = KB_WRITE
                    If szLTA > LTA Then szLTA = LTA
                        Do
                            If LTA > szLTA Then
                             
                                DTA = Left(FL.FD.DTA, szLTA)
                                FL.FD.DTA = Right(FL.FD.DTA, Len(FL.FD.DTA) - szLTA)
                                LTA = LTA - szLTA
                            Else
                                DTA = FL.FD.DTA
                                FL.FD.DTA = ""
                                LTA = 0
                            End If
                            
                        Put #FL.FD.iFN, nRec, DTA
                        nRec = nRec + szLTA
                        DoEvents
                        Loop Until LTA = 0
            FL.url.FI.BOOL.wB = True
        End If
    WF_OUT = FL
End Function

Public Function RF_IN(FL1 As FL_) As FL_
    Dim FL As FL_
    FL = FL1
    Dim LTA As Long
    Dim szLTA As Long
            If FL.url.FI.BOOL.oB Then

                    LTA = LOF(FL.FD.iFN)
                    Dim DTA As String
                    
                    szLTA = KB_READ
                    If szLTA > LTA Then szLTA = LTA
                        Do
                            If LTA > szLTA Then
                                DTA = String$(szLTA, Chr(32))
                                LTA = LTA - szLTA
                            Else
                            
                            DTA = String$(LTA, Chr(32))
                            LTA = 0
                            
                            End If
                        Get #FL.FD.iFN, , DTA

                         FL.FD.DTA = FL.FD.DTA & DTA
                         
                         DoEvents
                        Loop Until LTA = 0
                    FL.url.FI.BOOL.rB = True
            End If
    RF_IN = FL
End Function

Public Function RD_DF(GF1 As GF_, NO_EXT As Boolean) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
        
        Select Case GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.oB
            Case False
                GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.rB = False
            Case True
                GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.rP = vbOK
                'MsgBox(GF.WF.url.FIOD, vbOKCancel, "Discard any unsaved work?")
                'MSG_ "Discarded"
        End Select
        
        Select Case GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.oB And GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.rP = vbOK
            Case True
                GF.WF = RDIR(GF.WF, NO_EXT)
                GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.rB = True
            Case Else
                'GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.rB = MsgBox(GF.WF.url.DI.FFP, vbOKCancel, "Discard any unsaved work?")
                 GF.WF.url.DI.BOOL.oP = 1 ' usr_Cancel
        End Select

        RD_DF = GF
End Function

Private Function RDIR(FL1 As FL_, NO_EXT As Boolean) As FL_
    Dim sHX As String
    Dim buf As String
    Dim FL As FL_
    Dim AttrBool As Boolean
    FL = FL1
    FL.DL.szLST = -1

        Select Case FL.DL.vbDir.vbDR
            Case vbDOpt.of
                    FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting = FL.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbNormal
            Case vbDOpt.OD
                    FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting = FL.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbDirectory
            'Case vbDOpt.DF
        End Select

        sHX = Dir(FL.url.FIOD & D_dv, FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting)
        
             If FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting = FL.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbDirectory And Len(sHX) > 0 Then
              sHX = Dir$
             End If
            
            If FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting = FL.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbNormal And Len(sHX) > 0 Then
                buf = buf & sHX & eE_dv
                FL.DL.szLST = FL.DL.szLST + HXR
            End If
            
            Do While CBool(Len(sHX) > 0)
                sHX = Dir$
                 If FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting = FL.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbDirectory Then
                    If GetAttr(FL.url.FIOD & D_dv & sHX) = vbDirectory Then
                        AttrBool = True
                    Else
                        AttrBool = False
                    End If
                 Else
                    AttrBool = True
                 End If
                 
                 If AttrBool Then buf = buf & sHX & eE_dv: FL.DL.szLST = FL.DL.szLST + HXR
                DoEvents
            Loop
                
            If FL.DL.szLST > 0 Then
                If NO_EXT Then buf = Replace(buf, E_dv & FL.url.FI.EXT, vbNullString)
                    ReDim aBuf(FL.DL.szLST)
                        If FL.DL.vbDir.vbSetting = FL.XV.FV.FO.vbDir.vbNormal Then buf = Left(buf, Len(buf) - 4)
                        FL.DL.Lst = Split(buf, eE_dv, FL.DL.szLST)
            Else
                ReDim FL.DL.Lst(0)
            End If
  
      RDIR = FL
End Function
```

```
Public Function LD_IVK(vK As Byte, IVK As Byte, Optional NUL As Boolean = False) As String

LD_IVK = sVK

Public Sub IVK_CSK(sMSG As String, MWrap As Byte)
    Select Case MWrap
        Case MWU.MW_lo: CSK_SCRPT IVK_RTUN: IVK_SCRPT sMSG
        Case MWU.MW_hi: IVK_SCRPT sMSG: CSK_SCRPT IVK_RTUN
        Case MWU.MW_all: CSK_SCRPT IVK_RTUN: IVK_SCRPT sMSG: CSK_SCRPT IVK_RTUN
    End Select
End Sub

Public Sub IVK_SCRPT(sMSG As String)

Dim HxA As Integer
Dim KB_IN As String
Dim vk_ As Byte
Dim vki_ As Integer
Dim iLEN As Integer
iLEN = Len(sMSG)
Dim ivkB As Byte
For HxA = 1 To Len(sMSG)
    vk_ = Asc(Mid(sMSG, HxA, 1))
    vki_ = VkKeyScan(vk_)
    
     If Len(Hex(vki_)) > 2 Then
        vk_ = HIWORD(vki_)
        vki_ = LOWORD(vki_)
        ivkB = CByte(vki_)
            If vk_ = 1 Then
                KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(XVK.SHFT, 0)
                KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(ivkB, 0)
                KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(ivkB, 2)
                KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(XVK.SHFT, 2, CBool(HxA = iLEN))
            Else
                KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(ivkB, 0)
                KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(ivkB, 2, CBool(HxA = iLEN))
            End If
     Else
        ivkB = CByte(vki_)
        KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(ivkB, 0)
        KB_IN = KB_IN & LD_IVK(ivkB, 2, CBool(HxA = iLEN))
     End If
     
Next HxA

    CSK_SCRPT KB_IN
End Sub

Public Sub CSK_SCRPT(SCRPT As String, Optional IPTKM As Long = INPUT_KEYBOARD)
    Dim vK() As String
    Dim vks() As String
        vK() = Split(SCRPT, ds)
    Dim HxA As Integer
    Dim ubvk As Integer
        ubvk = UBound(vK)
    Dim KB_OUT() As KBI_
        ReDim KB_OUT(ubvk) As KBI_
    Dim vk_ As Byte
        For HxA = 0 To ubvk
            vks() = Split(vK(HxA), cs)
            If Len(Hex(vks(HXF))) > 2 Then
                vk_ = LOWORD(vks(HXF))
            Else
                vk_ = vks(HXF)
            End If
                KB_OUT(HxA).dwtype = IPTKM
                KB_OUT(HxA).dwFlags = vks(1)
                KB_OUT(HxA).wVK = vk_
                KB_OUT(HxA).wScan = MapVirtualKey(vk_, 0)
        Next HxA
        SendInput ubvk + HXR, KB_OUT(0), LenB(KB_OUT(HXF))
End Sub
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "MTH_RET"
Private Const Hex_8 = &H10000000
Private Const Hex_7 = &H1000000
Private Const Hex_6 = &H100000
Private Const Hex_5 = &H10000
Private Const Hex_4 = &H1000
Private Const Hex_3 = &H100
Private Const Hex_2 = &H10
Private Const Hex_1 = &H1

Public Function HIWORD(ByVal dwValue As Long) As Integer
    HIWORD = CInt("&h" & Left(Hex(dwValue), 1))
End Function

Public Function LOWORD(ByVal dwValue As Long) As Integer
    LOWORD = CInt("&h" & Right(Hex(dwValue), 2))
End Function

Public Function DEC_HEX2(HX1 As Byte, HX2 As Byte) As Long
   DEC_HEX2 = (HX1 * Hex_2) + (HX2 * Hex_1)
End Function

Public Function FIX_INTRVL(LP_INTRVL As Long, HP_INTRVL As Long, DoVBSlp As Long) As Long
    Dim FX_INT As Long
    FX_INT = HP_INTRVL - LP_INTRVL
        If FX_INT > &HFFFFFFF Then FIX_INTRVL = &HFFFFFFF
            FX_INT = FX_INT + DoVBSlp
            If FX_INT < 0 Then FX_INT = Abs(FX_INT)
FIX_INTRVL = FX_INT
End Function
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "MTH_RET_TXT"
Public CHR_2_3 As String * 2
Public CHR_4_5 As String * 2
Public Sub LD_CHR()
     CHR_2_3 = Chr(2) & Chr(3)
     CHR_4_5 = Chr(4) & Chr(5)
End Sub
Public Function LChr_FIO(sAN() As Long) As String
    LChr_FIO = Join(sAN, CHR_2_3)
End Function

Public Function Chr_FIO(TXT() As String) As String
    Chr_FIO = Join(TXT, CHR_2_3)
End Function

Public Function Chr_FIO1(TXT() As String) As String
    Chr_FIO1 = Join(TXT, CHR_4_5)
End Function

Public Function eFF(NME() As String) As String
    eFF = Join(NME, E_dv)
End Function

Public Function dFF(PTH() As String) As String
    dFF = Join(PTH, D_dv)
End Function

Public Function cFF(DBS() As String) As String
    cFF = Join(DBS, C_dv)
End Function
Public Function crlfFF(DBS() As String) As String
    crlfFF = Join(DBS, vbCrLf)
End Function

Public Function IMP_FT(txt1 As String, txt2 As String, txt3 As String, txt4 As String, txt5 As String, txt6 As String) As String
        IMP_FT = txt1 & Chr(32) & _
        txt2 & Chr(32) & _
        txt3 & Chr(32) & _
        txt4 & Chr(32) & _
        txt5 & Chr(32) & _
        txt6 & Chr(32)
        IMP_FT = RTrim(IMP_FT)
End Function

Public Function VAL_ITM(DL As String) As Boolean
     VAL_ITM = CBool(Left(DL, 1) = E_dv) Or CBool(DL = vbNullString)
End Function

Public Function VAL_ITMS(DL() As String) As OL_
    Dim HxA As Integer
    Dim HXA1 As Integer
    Dim szFL As Integer
    Dim rDL() As String
    
        szFL = UBound(DL)
        ReDim rDL(szFL) As String
        
        For HxA = HXF To szFL
            If VAL_ITM(DL(HxA)) Then rDL(HXA1) = DL(HxA): HXA1 = HXA1 + HXR
            DoEvents
        Next HxA
        
        VAL_ITMS.Lst = rDL
End Function
```

```
Public Function BRS_OPT_GSO_CDD(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
    Dim STRBT As Byte
    Dim STOBT As Byte
    
         GF = GF1
         STOBT = GF.GUI.GHX.GINDX + GF.WF.url.NXT.NXTBT
         GF.WF.url.DI.gOPT = STOBT
         ReDim GF.WF.url.DI.PN(0).BP(STOBT - HXR)
         
                For STRBT = HXR To STOBT
                    GF.WF.url.DI.PN(0).BP(STRBT - HXR) = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.bOPT(STRBT)
                Next
            
    BRS_OPT_GSO_CDD = GF
End Function

Public Function BRS_OPT_IDX_CDD(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
    Dim STRBT As Byte
    Dim STOBT As Byte
    
        GF = GF1
        
        STOBT = GF.GUI.GHX.GINDX
        GF.WF.url.DI.gOPT = STOBT
        STOBT = STOBT + GF.WF.url.NXT.NXTBT
        
        ReDim GF.WF.url.DI.PN(0).BP(STOBT - HXR)
            
                For STRBT = HXR To STOBT
                    GF.WF.url.DI.PN(0).BP(STRBT - HXR) = GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.bOPT(STRBT)
                Next
                
    BRS_OPT_IDX_CDD = GF

Public Function BRS_LST_GSO_CDD(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
    Dim STRBT As Byte
    Dim STOBT As Byte
    
         GF = GF1
         STOBT = GF.GUI.GHX.GINDX
         ReDim GF.WF.url.DI.PN(1).BP(STOBT - (HXR * (1 + Abs(CInt(STOBT > 1)))))
         
         If STOBT = HXR Then

            Else
                For STRBT = HXR To STOBT - HXR
                    GF.WF.url.DI.PN(1).BP(STRBT - HXR) = GNME(GF.GUI, STRBT, HXF)
                Next
        End If
    BRS_LST_GSO_CDD = GF
End Function
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "RET_PARSE"
Public Const PARSE_LST = "NONE,droids,Guns,Ships,Armor,Food,Buff,DTPD"
Public Const PARSE_CALC = "M,RM,CM,ADD,SUB,MLT,DIV"
Public PARSE_FILE As String
Public PARSE_BOOL As Boolean

Public Function PARSE_FTXT_(GF As GF_) As GF_
VbSleep 1

Select Case GF.GUI.gBRS.TXT(1).TXT
        Case "Ship Comp"
            PARSE_ShipC GF
        Case "Droid Craft"
            PARSE_DROID GF
        Case "Gun Craft"
            PARSE_GUN GF
        Case "Gun Prices"
            PARSE_GUNP GF
        Case "Droid Prices"
            PARSE_DROIDP GF
        Case "FD Craft"
            PARSE_FDC GF
        Case "RE_COMP"
            PARSE_DTDP GF
        Case Else
         PARSE_BOOL = False
    End Select
    
End Function

Public Sub PARSE_DTDP(GF As GF_)
    Dim fTXT As String
    Select Case PARSE_r
        Case 7
        
            fTXT = UC_DTA_IN_TxtT
                If InStr(1, fTXT, "ui_auc:[waypoint_to_vendor_name]") > 0 Then
                    fTXT = Replace(fTXT, "ui_auc:[waypoint_to_vendor_name]", "")
                    fTXT = Replace(fTXT, "(", "")
                    fTXT = Replace(fTXT, ")", "")
                    UC_DTA_OUT_TxtT fTXT
                End If
            PARSE_BOOL = False
        
        Case Else
            PARSE_BOOL = False
    End Select

End Sub



Private Function LD_FCE(GF As GF_) As String
    If Not PARSE_BOOL Or GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(2).TXT = "0FACE" Then
        LD_FCE = "&H00000000"
            PARSE_BOOL = True
         Else
            LD_FCE = PARSE_FILE
    End If
End Function

Private Function SPLT_FCE(sTXT As String) As String()
    Dim tLTxT As Long
    Dim TXT(3) As String
        Const DELIM = "||||||||||||||||||||"
        TXT(1) = Replace(sTXT, vbCrLf, "")
        TXT(2) = Left(TXT(1), 10)
        TXT(3) = RTrim(LTrim(Right(TXT(1), Len(TXT(1)) - 10)))
        SPLT_FCE = Split(TXT(3) & DELIM, "|")
    
End Function

Private Function SPLT_UM(GF As GF_) As String()
    Dim isTXT() As String
    Dim sTXT(2) As String
    Dim nStr As String
    Const m_ = "M"
        
    isTXT() = Split(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(3).TXT, "_")

    sTXT(0) = isTXT(0)
    If Len(isTXT(1)) > 1 Then
            nStr = Left(isTXT(1), 1)
            sTXT(1) = nStr & "LTRA"
            nStr = Right(isTXT(1), 1)
            sTXT(2) = nStr & "AX"
        Else
            nStr = Left(isTXT(1), 1)
                If nStr = m_ Then
                    sTXT(1) = nStr & "AX"
                    sTXT(2) = vbNullString
                Else
                    sTXT(1) = nStr & "LTRA"
                    sTXT(2) = vbNullString
                End If
    End If
 
    SPLT_UM = sTXT
End Function

Public Function RET_PARSE(tLTxT As Long, TXT() As String, sTXT() As String, tLen As Long) As String
    TXT(1) = Hex(tLTxT + 1)
    tLen = Len(CStr(TXT(1)))
    TXT(2) = Join(sTXT, "|")
    PARSE_FILE = "&H" & String(Abs(8 - tLen), "0") & TXT(1) & TXT(2)
    fTXT = Replace(TXT(2), "|", " ")
    fTXT = Replace(fTXT, "- ", "-")
    'fTXT = Replace(fTXT, "[]", "")
    
    RET_PARSE = RTrim(Replace(fTXT, "  ", " "))
End Function

Public Function RET_SPLIT_1(isTXT() As String, sTXT() As String) As String()
        sTXT(3) = isTXT(0) & "-"
        sTXT(4) = isTXT(1)
        RET_SPLIT_1 = sTXT
End Function

Public Function RET_SPLIT_2(isTXT() As String, sTXT() As String) As String()
        sTXT(5) = isTXT(0)
        sTXT(1) = isTXT(1)
        sTXT(2) = isTXT(2)
        RET_SPLIT_2 = sTXT
End Function

Public Sub PARSE_DROIDP(GF As GF_)
    Dim tLen As Long
    Dim tLTxT As Long
    Dim fTXT As String
    Dim HxA As Integer

    Select Case PARSE_r
        Case 1
                
                If GF.GUI.CMI.cIDX.IDX = 4 Then
                    If IsNumeric(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(4).TXT) Then
                         If IsNumeric(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(3).TXT) Then
                        
                            tLTxT = GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(3).TXT
                            
                            tLen = ((tLTxT / 100) * 1000) + ((tLTxT / 10) * 10000) '
                            
                            tLTxT = tLen + Abs((tLTxT - 100)) * 100
                            HxA = Left(tLTxT, 1)
                                If HxA < 3 Then: HxA = (Abs(HxA - 5) * 4112)
                                
                            tLTxT = tLTxT + HxA
                            tLen = GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(4).TXT
                            fTXT = String(Abs(Len(CStr(tLen)) - 4), "0") & tLen
                            tLTxT = tLTxT + (Right(fTXT, 1) * 10)
                            tLTxT = tLTxT + (Right(fTXT, 2) * 1)
                            tLTxT = tLTxT + (Right(fTXT, 3) * 1)
                            tLTxT = tLTxT + (Right(fTXT, 4) * 1)
                            
                            fTXT = CStr(CLng(tLTxT) - 18879)
                            fTXT = Left(fTXT, Len(fTXT) - 1) & "5"
                            UC_DTA_OUT_TxtT fTXT
                         End If
                    End If
                End If
        Case Else

    End Select
    PARSE_BOOL = False
End Sub

Public Sub PARSE_ShipC(GF As GF_)
    Dim tLen As Long
    Dim tLTxT As Long
    Dim TXT(2) As String
    Dim fTXT As String
    Dim sTXT() As String
    Dim isTXT() As String
Dim HxA As Integer
    TXT(0) = LD_FCE(GF)
   
    Select Case PARSE_r
        Case 3
                
                If Left(TXT(0), 2) = "&H" Then
                      tLTxT = CLng(Left(TXT(0), 10))
                      sTXT = SPLT_FCE(TXT(0))
                    If tLTxT <> GF.GUI.CMI.cIDX.IDX - 1 And tLTxT <> 0 Then tLTxT = -1
                        Select Case tLTxT
                        Case 0
                          If Len(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(2).TXT) > 4 Then
                            sTXT(0) = "[Darkstar]"
                        End If
                        Case 1
                        If Len(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(2).TXT) > 2 Then
                            isTXT() = Split(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(2).TXT, "_")
                            sTXT = RET_SPLIT_1(isTXT, sTXT)
                        End If
                        Case 2
                        If Len(GF.GUI.gBRS.Lst(3).TXT) > 2 Then
                         isTXT = SPLT_UM(GF)
                            sTXT = RET_SPLIT_2(isTXT, sTXT)
                            sTXT(5) = "(SEC " & sTXT(5) & ")"
                            isTXT() = PARSE_CRAFT(sTXT(3))
                            
                            
                                For HxA = 0 To UBound(isTXT)
                                    sTXT(6 + HxA) = isTXT(HxA)
                                Next HxA
                        
                        PARSE_BOOL = False
                        End If
                            Case Else
                            PARSE_BOOL = False
                        End Select
                        
                    UC_DTA_OUT_TxtT RET_PARSE(tLTxT, TXT, sTXT, tLen)
                End If
       
        Case Else
            PARSE_BOOL = False
    End Select

End Sub
```

```
Attribute VB_Name = "VK_IN"
Public Sub SND_IKEY(Data As String)
    SetFullScreen
    VbSleep 1000
        Dim sHXA As Long
        Dim sDTA As String
        Dim ascS_ As String * 1
        Dim ascS2_ As String * 1
        Dim sDTA_ As String
        szDTA = Len(Data)
            For sHXA = HXR To szDTA
                If sHXA <= szDTA Then
                sDTA = Mid(Data, sHXA, 2 - Abs(CBool(sHXA = szDTA)))
                ascS_ = Left(sDTA, HXR)
                ascS2_ = Right(sDTA, HXR)
                    If ascS_ = ascS2_ Then
                        'ascS2_ = Chr(Asc(Left(ascS_, 1)) + 4)
                        ascS2_ = Chr(Asc(Left(ascS_, 1)))
                        Else
                        ascS2_ = ascS_
                    End If
                    sDTA_ = sDTA_ & ascS2_
                End If
                LD_IKEY sDTA_
                sDTA_ = ""
               
            Next sHXA
            
End Sub

Public Sub LD_IKEY(Data As String)
    Dim szDTA As Long
        szDTA = Len(Data) - HXR
            Dim KB_OUT() As KBI_
            ReDim KB_OUT(szDTA) As KBI_
Dim vk_ As Integer


            Dim HxA As Long
                For HxA = HXF To szDTA
         
                vK = VkKeyScan(Asc(Mid(Data, HxA + HXR, 1)))
                    KB_OUT(HxA).dwType = INPUT_KEYBOARD

                    KB_OUT(HxA).dwFlags = KEYEVENTF_KEYUP
                    
    If Len(Hex(vK)) > 2 Then vK = LOWORD(vK)
    KB_OUT(HxA).wVK = vK
   ' KB_OUT(HXA).wScan = MapVirtualKey(VK, 0)
                Next HxA
    SND_IKEY_ KB_OUT
End Sub
```

```
CBTXT = CBTXT & hwnd & ":*:" & lParam & vbCrLf

Dim retval As Long
retval = EnumChildWindows(Wins.MDI, AddressOf EnumChildProc, 0)
CBTXT = retval & "::" & Wins.MDI & vbCrLf
End Sub
```

```
Private Sub PROC_GUI(XV As XV_, CMI As cMI_)
    'SHOW_WATCH = True
    Dim BRS As GUI_BRS
     Dim OPT As GUI_OPT
     SHOW_WATCH = False
   If SHOW_WATCH Then config_watch 'Watch Application
    
        OPT.BTN.CLK = CBool(CMI.CMDE.MDE = XV.FV.BTN)
        OPT.BTN.cdt = XV.UV.bAbs
        OPT.BTN.wcCMT = "CBool(MDE=BTN)"
        
        OPT.mOPT.GSO = GSO(gOPT_M)
        OPT.mOPT.cdt = XV.UV.byte
        OPT.mOPT.wcCMT = "GSO(gOPT_M)"
        
        OPT.bOPT.GSO = GSO(gOPT_B)
        OPT.bOPT.cdt = XV.UV.byte
        OPT.bOPT.wcCMT = "GSO(gOPT_B)"
        
        
            Dim HxA As Integer
            
            For HxA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_LST_ULEN
                BRS.Lst(HxA).gSI = gLST_BRS(HxA).ListIndex
                BRS.Lst(HxA).iCDT = XV.UV.ibool
                
                BRS.Lst(HxA).TXT = gLST_BRS(HxA).Text
                BRS.Lst(HxA).sCDT = XV.UV.STR
                BRS.Lst(HxA).wcCMT = "(" & HxA & ")" & "*=ListIndex*=Text"
            Next HxA
            
            
            For HxA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_TXT_ULEN
                BRS.TXT(HxA).TXT = gTXT_BRS(HxA).Text
                BRS.TXT(HxA).cdt = XV.UV.STR
                BRS.TXT(HxA).wcCMT = "(" & HxA & ")" & "*=Text"
            Next HxA
            
            
            For HxA = HXR To XV.FV.BRS_CPT_ULEN
                BRS.CPT(HxA).gCPT = gCPT_B(HxA).Caption
                BRS.CPT(HxA).cdt = XV.UV.STR
                BRS.CPT(HxA).wcCMT = "(" & HxA & ")" & "*=Caption"
            Next HxA
           
           Dim GF As GF_
           GF = PROC_GUID(X_HEX(C_HEX(XV, CMI, OPT, BRS)))
       If SHOW_WATCH Then Watch_Hex GF.GUI
 
        'Call App.code
End Sub

Private Sub PROC_GUI_EVNT(Index As Integer, MDE As Byte, iCDT As Byte, mCDT As Boolean, wcCMTi As String, wcCMTm As String, XV As XV_)
    Dim CMI As cMI_
    
          CMI.cIDX.IDX = CByte(Index)
          CMI.cIDX.cdt = XV.UV.byte
          CMI.cIDX.wcCMT = wcCMTi
          
          CMI.CMDE.CDT_CLCK = mCDT
          CMI.CMDE.MDE = MDE
          CMI.CMDE.cdt = XV.UV.byte
          CMI.CMDE.wcCMT = wcCMTm
          PROC_GUI XV, CMI
End Sub

Private Sub cCalc_Click()
    Select Case calcLST.ListIndex
    Case 0
    If calcTXT(2) <> "" Then CalcClip = CLng(calcTXT(2))
    Case 1
        calcTXT(2) = CalcClip
    Case 2
        CalcClip = 0
    Case 3
        calcTXT(2) = CLng(calcTXT(0)) + CLng(calcTXT(1))
    Case 4
        calcTXT(2) = CLng(calcTXT(0)) - CLng(calcTXT(1))
    Case 5
        calcTXT(2) = CLng(calcTXT(0)) * CLng(calcTXT(1))
    Case 6
        calcTXT(2) = CLng(calcTXT(0)) / CLng(calcTXT(1))
    End Select
End Sub

Public Sub SND_KEY()
    Dim sTXT As String
    ENBL_CTRL_1 False
    
    If Not cCWIN.Value Then
    
        If frmTXT.Value Then
           If ivTXT.Enabled Then FTxtT.SetFocus
        Else
          If ivTXT.Enabled Then ivTXT.SetFocus
        End If
        
    End If

    
    If cUI.Value = 0 Then
            If Not fTXT Then
                If frmTXT.Value Then
                    sTXT = FTxtT.Text
                    'FTxtT.Text = ""
                Else
                    sTXT = ivTXT.Text
                    ivTXT.Text = ""
                End If
            End If
        Else
        
          If vkCMB.ListIndex > -1 Then sTXT = CMB_DTASTR(vkCMB.ListIndex)
            
    End If

      If Len(sTXT) Then SND_IVK_REC sTXT, cUI.Value, frmTXT.Value, GSO(oCCP)
        
    ENBL_CTRL_1 True
End Sub

Public Sub vkOPT_CLCK(Index As Integer)

  Dim ITMS() As String
  Dim dITMS() As Integer
  Dim mkITMS() As String
  Dim HxA As Integer
  Dim szITM As Integer
  Dim SPLT As String
  Dim KM_ITMS  As String

  Clear_vkCMB_
 
Select Case Index
Case 0
            KM_ITMS = KM_ITMS1 & ",MAP,MNU,MAIL,OPT,PLNT"
        
                    SPLT = LD_IVKS(Asc("i"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("i"), 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("d"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("d"), 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("m"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("m"), 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("g"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("g"), 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("n"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("n"), 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("o"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("o"), 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("p"), 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVKS(Asc("p"), 2, True)
Case 1
            KM_ITMS = KM_ITMS2 & ",COPY,UP,DWN,LFT,RGHT,TAB,BAK,RTRN"

                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.CNTRL, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbKeyV, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbKeyV, 2)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.CNTRL, 2, True) & CHR_2_3


                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.DLT, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.DLT, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.CNTRL, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbKeyA, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbKeyA, 2)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.CNTRL, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.END_, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.END_, 2)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.SHFT, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.HME, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.HME, 2)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.SHFT, 2, True)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.DLT, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.DLT, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.CNTRL, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbKeyC, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbKeyC, 2)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.CNTRL, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.UP, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.UP, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.DWN, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.DWN, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.LFT, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.LFT, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.RGT, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.RGT, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.TAB_, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.TAB_, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.BAK, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.BAK, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
                    
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.RTRN, 0)
                    SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK.RTRN, 2, True)

Case 2
    szITM = Abs(&H7F - &H70)
    ReDim ITMS(szITM)
    
    Dim iHXA As Integer
           ' KM_ITMS = KM_ITMS & "ALT" & cs
           ' SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(XVK., 0)
           ' SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(vbkeyalt, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
           ' iHXA = iHXA + 1


           
        For HxA = HxA + iHXA To szITM + iHXA
            KM_ITMS = KM_ITMS & "F" & HxA + 1 - iHXA & cs
            SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(HxA - iHXA + &H70, 0)
            SPLT = SPLT & LD_IVK(HxA - iHXA + &H70, 2, True) & CHR_2_3
        Next HxA 'LD_FKEY
End Select

    mkITMS() = Split(SPLT, CHR_2_3)
    ITMS() = Split(KM_ITMS, cs)
    szITM = UBound(mkITMS)
    vkCMB_addItems_s ITMS, mkITMS, szITM
    
   SWG.SWGC1.vkCMB_SELIDX = 0
   cMDE_CLCK = False
   
End Sub


Private Sub Command2_Click(Index As Integer)
    Option4(0).Value = 1
        Select Case Index
              Case 0: FTxtT = ""
              Case 1
                      If KILL_PROC_PGE_ Then
                          KILL_PROC_PGE_ = False
                      End If
                          gLBL(0).Caption = "::MOVE HERE TO STOP::"
                          If Not PROC_PGE Then Exit Sub
              Case 2: If Not KILL_PROC_PGE_ Then KILL_PROC_PGE_ = True
              Case 3: CLIP_cFTXT clipHwnd, PM_GTXL(clipHwnd): gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::COPY::LOCAL"
              Case 4: CLIP_pFTXT clipHwnd, PM_GTXL(clipHwnd): gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::PASTE::LOCAL"
              Case 5: PM_UNDO clipHwnd: gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::UNDO::GAME"
              Case 6: PM_CUT clipHwnd: gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::CUT::GAME"
              Case 7: PM_UNDO clipHwnd: gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::UNDO::GAME"
              Case 8: PM_CUT clipHwnd: gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::CUT::GAME"
              Case 9: CLIP_pFTXT clipHwnd, PM_GTXL(clipHwnd): gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::PASTE::LOCAL"
              Case 10: CLIP_cFTXT clipHwnd, PM_GTXL(clipHwnd): gLBL(0).Caption = "CMD::COPY::LOCAL"
          End Select
    SWG.SetFocus
End Sub
```

```
    y As Long

    hwnd    As Long
    message As Long
    wParam  As Long
    lParam  As Long
    time    As Long
    pt      As tagPOINT
End Type
Private Declare Function GetWindowThreadProcessId Lib "user32" (ByVal hwnd As Long, lpdwProcessId As Long) As Long
Public idProc As Long
Public idThread As Long
Private bHooked      As Boolean
Private hHook        As Long
Private hHwndToSniff As Long

Private Const HC_Action As Long = &H0

Private Const PM_NOREMOVE   As Long = &H0
Private Const PM_REMOVE     As Long = &H1

Private Const WH_GETMESSAGE     As Long = &H3
Private Const WM_RBUTTONDOWN    As Long = &H204

'http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms644974%28v=vs.85%29.aspx
Private Declare Function CallNextHookEx Lib "user32" _
    (ByVal hHook As Long, ByVal ncode As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, lParam As Any) As Long

'http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms644990%28v=vs.85%29.aspx
Private Declare Function SetWindowsHookEx Lib "user32" _
    Alias "SetWindowsHookExA" _
    (ByVal idHook As Long, ByVal lpfn As Long, ByVal hmod As Long, ByVal dwThreadId As Long) As Long

'http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms644993%28v=vs.85%29.aspx
Private Declare Function UnhookWindowsHookEx Lib "user32" _
    (ByVal hHook As Long) As Long

Private Function GetThreadID()
'idThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(Wins.Frame, idProc)
idThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(Wins.Frame, idProc)
End Function


Public Sub RemoveHook()
    If bHooked Then
        UnhookWindowsHookEx hHook
        Form1.Label2.Caption = "unhooked"
        bHooked = False
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub SetHook()
    GetThreadID
    If Not bHooked Then
        hHook = SetWindowsHookEx(WH_GETMESSAGE, AddressOf GetMsgProc, 0, idThread)
        If hHook > 0 Then
        Form1.Label2.Caption = "Hooked"
            bHooked = True
           
        Else
            Debug.Assert False
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Private Function GetMsgProc(ByVal uCode As Long _
    , ByVal wParam As Long _
    , ByRef lParam As MSG) As Long
    If uCode = 0 Then
        If wParam = PM_REMOVE Then
            If lParam.message = WM_LBUTTONDOWN Then
                If lParam.hwnd = Form1.hwnd Then
                 CBTXT = CBTXT & lParam.message
                End If
            End If
        End If
    End If

    GetMsgProc = CallNextHookEx(hHook, uCode, wParam, lParam)
End Function
```
