Attribute VB_Name = "ABC_FEL_MOD_WDISP"
Private Type ww1_
    BRS_TXT As String
    BRS_bCMD As String
    BRS_bOPT  As String
    BRS_mOPT  As String
    BRS_PTH As String
    BRS_MSG  As String
    BRS_EXE  As String
    BRS_EXE_CPY  As String
    FT As String
    b_SWCH  As Boolean
    b_GUID  As Boolean
    b_oBND  As Boolean
    b_FLO  As Boolean
    b_MOD  As Boolean
End Type

Private Type ww2_
    UDMI As String
    FT As String
End Type

Private Type ww3_
    disp  As String
    FT As String
End Type

Public wws1  As ww1_
Public wws2  As ww2_
Public wws3  As ww3_

Public Function DISP_WWS_SWCH(icase_ As Long, GUI As GUI_) As GF_
   ' If icase_ < 1 Then
        If Not wws1.b_GUID And Not wws1.b_oBND And Not wws1.b_FLO And Not wws1.b_MOD Then
             SET_DISP_WW_STR
             TMPLT_WW_SWCH icase_, GUI
             DISP_WW wws1.FT, wws2.FT, wws3.FT
        End If
   ' End If
End Function

Public Function DISP_WWS_GUID(icase_ As Integer, GUI As GUI_, IDX As Integer) As GF_
   '  If icase_ < 1 Then
        If Not wws1.b_SWCH And Not wws1.b_oBND And Not wws1.b_FLO And Not wws1.b_MOD Then
            SET_DISP_WW_STR
            TMPLT_WW_GUID icase_, GUI, IDX
            DISP_WW wws1.FT, wws2.FT, wws3.FT
        End If
    ' End If
End Function

Public Sub DISP_WW(lbl As String, txt As String, disp As String)
    SWG.SWGC1.gLBL_(0) = lbl
    WWF.Text1 = txt
    SWG.SWGC1.TxtT_ disp
End Sub

Public Sub SET_DISP_WW_STR()
    wws1.BRS_EXE = ""
    wws1.BRS_TXT = ""
    wws1.BRS_bCMD = ""
    wws1.BRS_bOPT = ""
    wws1.BRS_mOPT = ""
    wws1.BRS_PTH = ""
    wws1.BRS_MSG = ""
    wws1.BRS_EXE_CPY = ""
    wws1.FT = ""
    wws2.UDMI = ""
    wws2.FT = ""
    wws3.disp = ""
    wws3.FT = ""
End Sub

Public Sub SET_DISP_WW_Bool()
    wws1.b_SWCH = False
    wws1.b_GUID = False
    wws1.b_FLO = False
    wws1.b_MOD = False
    wws1.b_oBND = False
End Sub

Public Sub TMPLT_WW_SWCH(case_ As Long, GUI As GUI_)
  If GUI.gOPT.BTN.CLK Then wws1.BRS_bCMD = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.bCMD(GUI.CMI.cIDX.IDX))
    wws1.BRS_bOPT = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.bOPT(GUI.gOPT.bOPT.GSO))
    wws1.BRS_mOPT = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.mOPT(GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO))
    wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.PTH.PTH_BRS)
    
    Dim icase_ As Long
     If case_ = -1 Then icase_ = case_
     If case_ > 0 Then icase_ = 1

        Select Case icase_
            Case 0
                wws1.BRS_MSG = "NO GUID ::"
                wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(GUI.GUID)
                    
            Case 1
            
            Dim siHEX As String
            Dim iHex As Integer

            If GUI.CMI.cMDE.MDE = GUI.XV.FV.BTN Then iHex = SC_ARY_ULEN_BTN + 1: siHEX = "BTN" ': ADPTR.hFile(0) = 0: ADPTR.hFile(1) = iHex: ADPTR.hFile(2) = siHEX: ADPTR.hFile(3) = GUI.GUID
            If GUI.CMI.cMDE.MDE = GUI.XV.FV.Lst Then iHex = SC_ARY_ULEN_Lst + 1: siHEX = "Lst" ': ADPTR.hFile(0) = 1:: ADPTR.hFile(1) = iHex: ADPTR.hFile(2) = siHEX: ADPTR.hFile(3) = GUI.GUID
            If GUI.CMI.cMDE.MDE = GUI.XV.FV.OPTb Then iHex = SC_ARY_ULEN_OPTb + 1: siHEX = "OPTb" ': ADPTR.hFile(0) = 2:: ADPTR.hFile(1) = iHex: ADPTR.hFile(2) = siHEX: ADPTR.hFile(3) = GUI.GUID
            
                wws1.BRS_MSG = "Found GUID(FUNCT):"
                wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(GUI.GUID)
            
                wws3.disp = "SC_ARY_ULEN_" & siHEX & " = " & CStr(iHex) & vbCrLf
                wws3.disp = wws3.disp & "ReDim SC_ARY_" & siHEX & "(SC_ARY_ULEN_" & siHEX & ")" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
                wws3.disp = wws3.disp & "SC_ARY_" & siHEX & "(" & iHex & ") =" & CStr(GUI.GUID)
                 
            Case Else
                wws1.BRS_MSG = "OFF GUID "
                wws3.disp = "Case " & CStr(GUI.GUID)
            End Select
      
        
            wws1.b_SWCH = True
            wws1.FT = IMP_FT(wws1.BRS_MSG, wws1.BRS_PTH, wws1.BRS_bCMD, wws1.BRS_mOPT, wws1.BRS_bOPT, wws1.BRS_TXT)
            'wws2.FT = IMP_FT(wws2.UDMI, "", "", "", "", "")
            wws3.FT = IMP_FT(wws3.disp, "", "", "", "", "")
           
            
End Sub

Public Sub TMPLT_WW_GUID(case_ As Integer, GUI As GUI_, obnd_idx As Integer)
  If GUI.gOPT.BTN.CLK Then wws1.BRS_bCMD = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.bCMD(GUI.CMI.cIDX.IDX))
    wws1.BRS_bOPT = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.bOPT(GUI.gOPT.bOPT.GSO))
    wws1.BRS_mOPT = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.mOPT(GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO))
    wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(GUI.XV.FV.FO.PTH.PTH_BRS)
    
    Dim icase_ As Integer
     If case_ = -1 Then icase_ = case_
     If case_ > -1 Then icase_ = 0

        Select Case icase_
        
            Case -1
                wws1.BRS_MSG = "NO oBnd ::"
                wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(obnd_idx)
                    
            Case 0
             Dim siHEX As String
             Dim iHex As Integer
   
             If GUI.CMI.cMDE.MDE = GUI.XV.FV.BTN Then iHex = SC_ARY_ULEN_BTN + 1: siHEX = "BTN"
             If GUI.CMI.cMDE.MDE = GUI.XV.FV.Lst Then iHex = SC_ARY_ULEN_Lst + 1: siHEX = "Lst"
             If GUI.CMI.cMDE.MDE = GUI.XV.FV.OPTb Then iHex = SC_ARY_ULEN_OPTb + 1: siHEX = "OPTb"


                wws1.BRS_MSG = "WW_CALL : Case ("
                wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(obnd_idx) & " ) ^ "
                wws1.BRS_TXT = "^ GUID::(FUNCT) [" & GUI.GUID & "]"
                wws3.disp = "Case :: GF_GUID_MDE (" & CStr(obnd_idx) & ") [" & siHEX & "]"

            Case Else
                 wws1.BRS_MSG = "OFF oBnd:"
                 wws1.BRS_PTH = CStr(GUI.GUID)
                'wws2.UDMI = "oBnd(" & obnd_idx & ")::"
                 wws3.disp = "Case " & CStr(obnd_idx)

        End Select
            wws1.b_MOD = True
            wws1.b_GUID = True
            wws1.FT = IMP_FT(wws1.BRS_MSG, wws1.BRS_PTH, wws1.BRS_bCMD, wws1.BRS_mOPT, wws1.BRS_bOPT, wws1.BRS_TXT)
            'wws2.FT = IMP_FT(wws2.UDMI, "", "", "", "", "")
            wws3.FT = IMP_FT(wws3.disp, "", "", "", "", "")
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "ABC_FEL_MOD_WWIN"

Public PCKT_BUFF As String
Public PCKT_VIEW As Boolean
Public PCKT_VIEW_IDX(UDMI_LEN) As Integer
Public SHOW_WATCH As Boolean

Public Function RET_CRLF(Add_CRLF As Boolean) As String
   RET_CRLF = Left(vbCrLf, Abs(CInt(CBool(Add_CRLF))) + Abs(CInt(CBool(Add_CRLF))))
End Function

Public Sub APD_PBUF(PKT As String, Optional Add_CRLF As Boolean = False)
    PCKT_BUFF = PCKT_BUFF & PKT & vbCrLf & RET_CRLF(Add_CRLF)
End Sub

Public Function DISPL_PCKT_BUFF() As String
    WWF.PCKT_TXT.Text = PCKT_BUFF
    PCKT_BUFF = ""
End Function


Public Sub Watch_Hex(GUI As GUI_)
Dim iUDM As Integer
Dim iHex As Integer
    iUDM = HXF: iHex = HXR
        
    For GUI.GHX.iUDM = HXF To GUI.GHX.XV.UV.UDMI_LEN
            APD_PBUF "HEX::" & "(" & GUI.GHX.iUDM & ")::" & Hex(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(GUI.GHX.iUDM))
    Next GUI.GHX.iUDM
    APD_PBUF "_____________________________", False
    
    For GUI.GHX.iUDM = HXF To GUI.GHX.XV.UV.UDMI_LEN
            APD_PBUF "DEC::" & "(" & GUI.GHX.iUDM & ")::" & GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(GUI.GHX.iUDM)
    Next GUI.GHX.iUDM
    
    APD_PBUF "_____________________________", False
    
    For iUDM = HXF To GUI.GHX.XV.UV.UDMI_LEN
    
        APD_PBUF "_____________________________", True
        APD_PBUF "::" & Hex(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))
        APD_PBUF "::" & GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM)
        APD_PBUF "GUI::UDMI (" & iUDM & ")"
        APD_PBUF "_____________________________", True
        
        Dim HXA As Integer
                
          For iHex = HXR To HXO - HXR
          
            HXA = iHex + HXR
        
           Select Case GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt
    
            Case GUI.XV.UV.BOOL
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::CMT :: ?=" & GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::cdT :: ?=" & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt)
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::Bool:: " & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).BOOL)
                APD_PBUF "oBnd::HEX:: " & Mid(Hex(CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))), HXA, 1), True
                
            Case GUI.XV.UV.byte
                APD_PBUF GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::CMT :: ?=" & GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::cdT ::  ?=" & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt)
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::byte:: " & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).byt)
                APD_PBUF "oBnd::UDMI:: " & Mid(Hex(CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))), HXA, 1), True
                
            Case GUI.XV.UV.str
                APD_PBUF GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::cdT ::  ?=" & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt)
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::Str:: " & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).str)
                APD_PBUF "oBnd::UDMI:: " & Mid(Hex(CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))), HXA, 1), True

            Case GUI.XV.UV.iAbs
                APD_PBUF GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::cdT ::  ?=" & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt)
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::iAbs:: " & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).Int)
                APD_PBUF "oBnd::UDMI:: " & Mid(Hex(CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))), HXA, 1), True

            Case GUI.XV.UV.bAbs
                APD_PBUF GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::cdT ::  ?=" & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt)
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::bAbs:: " & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).Int)
                APD_PBUF "oBnd::UDMI:: " & Mid(Hex(CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))), HXA, 1), True
            
            Case GUI.XV.UV.Int
                APD_PBUF GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).CMT
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::cdT ::  ?=" & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).cdt)
                APD_PBUF "iBnd::bAbs:: " & CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.iBND(iUDM).HX(iHex).Int)
                APD_PBUF "oBnd::UDMI:: " & Mid(Hex(CStr(GUI.GHX.UDMI.oBnd(iUDM))), HXA, 1), True

                        
         End Select
   
    
    Next iHex
  Next iUDM
  
   DISPL_PCKT_BUFF

End Sub

Public Sub PEEK_PCKT()

Private Sub sendNowWrapALL(STR As String, vK As Integer)
    sendKeyNow vK, MapVirtualKey(vK, 0)
        sendKeysNow STR
    sendKeyNow vK, MapVirtualKey(vK, 0)
End Sub

Private Sub sendNowWrapLo(STR As String, vK As Integer)
    sendKeyNow vK, MapVirtualKey(vK, 0)
        sendKeysNow STR
End Sub

Private Sub sendNowWrapHi(STR As String, vK As Integer)
        sendKeysNow STR
    sendKeyNow vK, MapVirtualKey(vK, 0)
End Sub
  
Public Sub KeyDown(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    'VbSleep 10
    keybd_event vK, scan, 0, 0
End Sub

Public Sub KeyUp(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    'VbSleep 10
    keybd_event vK, scan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0
End Sub

Public Sub KeyPress(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    KeyDown vK, scan
    KeyUp vK, scan
End Sub

Public Sub ShiftOnn()
    KeyDown VK_LSHIFT, MapVirtualKey(VK_LSHIFT, 0)
End Sub

Public Sub ShiftOff()
    KeyUp VK_LSHIFT, MapVirtualKey(VK_LSHIFT, 0)
End Sub

Public Sub CtrlOnn()
'&H11
    sendKeyNowDWN &H11, 0
End Sub

Public Sub CtrlOff()
    sendKeyNowUP &H11, 0
End Sub

Public Sub VKTAB_D()
    KeyDown VK_TAB, 0
End Sub

Public Sub VKTAB_U()
    KeyUp VK_TAB, 0
End Sub

Public Sub sendKeysNow(Tstr As String)
Dim TXT As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim vK As Integer
    Dim LSTR As Long
     TXT = Tstr
    LSTR = Len(TXT)
    
    Dim CHAR As String * 1
    Dim CHAR2 As String * 2
    Dim scan As Integer
    
    If SWG.SWGC1.cSWG_ Then
    TXT = Replace(TXT, vbCrLf, Chr(10))
    TXT = Replace(TXT, Chr(9), String$(8, Chr(32)))
    End If
    
        For i = 1 To LSTR
        
        CHAR2 = Mid(TXT, i, 2)
        
            If CHAR2 = vbCrLf Then
                CHAR = Right(CHAR2, 1)
                i = i + 1
            Else
                CHAR = Left(CHAR2, 1)
            End If
            
            If Asc(CHAR) = 10 Then
             vK = VK_RETURN
             scan = MapVirtualKey(vK, 0)
            Else
            vK = VkKeyScan(Asc(CHAR))
             scan = 0
            End If
            
            
            sendKeyNow vK, scan
            VbSleep 9
        Next i
End Sub
Public Sub sendKeyNowUP(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    If Len(Hex(vK)) > 2 Then
        KEY_SHFT LOWORD(vK), scan
            Else
        KeyUp vK, scan
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub sendKeyNowDWN(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    If Len(Hex(vK)) > 2 Then
        KEY_SHFT LOWORD(vK), scan
            Else
        KeyDown vK, scan
    End If
End Sub
Public Sub sendKeyNow(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    If Len(Hex(vK)) > 2 Then
        KEY_SHFT LOWORD(vK), scan
            Else
        KeyPress vK, scan
    End If
End Sub

End Sub
Public Sub KEY_SHFT(vK As Integer, scan As Integer)
    ShiftOnn
       KeyPress vK, scan
    ShiftOff
End Sub
